in_latin.name: Maximus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'maximus', meaning 'greatest' or 'the greatest'. This name is used in various contexts throughout history, including in the Roman Empire and in early Christianity.

in_english.name: Maxim
in_english.long_meaning: From the Old English word 'maxtim', meaning 'greatest'. This name is derived from the Old English 'mæg' meaning 'power' and 'tim' meaning 'time'. It is similar to the modern English word 'maximum'.

The name represents the idea of being a great hymn or song to God. It is a reminder for Christians to live their lives as a testament to God's greatness and love.
